description.en: Maintainer-published native DSH bundles. Review pinned sources before installing.
description.zh: 由项目维护者发布的 DSH 原生能力包索引；安装前可核对固定来源。

title.zh: 军团 · Harness 协同进化战队

description.en: Choose companions and collaboration style, then start native DSH initial and weekly work for discovery, cooperation and improvement. Includes durable recovery, pause, shared tools and source adaptation. Users configure their own models and optional Legion core; scheduling is not proof of improvement.
description.zh: 选择战友与协作方式，一次组队自动开启首轮和每周发现、协作与改进。提供持久恢复、暂停、开放工具和源码适配；使用自己的模型及按需安装的军团核心，任务安排不冒充改进成功。
